title: Eroko-san on the Attack
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shindou Eroko is a 27-year-old NEET with an online persona as a lewd, busty woman; with her glasses off she becomes that persona. Broke, she takes a handyman job and meets high schooler Hoshi-kun, who is exactly her type, and the comedy follows her forward attempts to get close to him. It is set after the author's earlier series Henjo.
life_message: Awkward, eccentric people can still find love and grow as a couple.
